whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Bansi Vihar Restaurant,

I noticed your iconic restaurant has massive trust with 9,850+ reviews on Fraser Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking and menu page.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct table reservation, digital multi-cuisine menu, aur Google map directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/bansivihar

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Bansi Vihar Restaurant, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Bansi Vihar Restaurant on Fraser Road) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with digital multi-cuisine menu, table reservation, and your 9,800+ reviews showcase. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual menu items aur photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain."
